finding: The fine for running or using a shooting range the authority has shut down points at § 12(2) sentence 2, deleted on 1 September 2020; the ban moved to § 27a WaffG, which carries no fine.

kind: reference to a section never enacted
finding: Tax offices must send data to a coordinating body defined in GwG § 50c, which was never enacted (its bill lapsed); the official text notes the amendment 'ist nicht ausführbar, da § 50c nicht vorhanden ist'.
The overtime rule for minors applies arts. 375, 376 sole paragraph, 378 and 384, all repealed; the 48-hour notice duty lived in art. 376.
Pest-control costs may be charged to those who evade 'the duties under Article 151'; art. 151 was repealed with effect from 1 January 2025.
Higher criminal fine ceilings in force on 1 January 2022 by a decree published on 5 January 2022.
Fines a vehicle keeper for not entering changes 'contrary to § 38(3)'; § 38 expired on 16 June 2021 and the duty moved to § 38a, which the fine list does not mention.
Fines for handling cargo or entering particular refuge harbours 'contrary to' §§ 27, 29 and 30, all deleted in 2019.
The fine item points at § 4 (deleted 2024) and § 7 (still in force).
The fine item points at § 101, deleted with effect from 1 January 2025, and was left unchanged when § 111 was amended again for 2026.
The deadlines for raising nullities point at arts. 500 and 537, repealed by Lei 11.719/2008; courts re-read them (STJ Tema 1.114).
Confiscation without conviction still names arts. 213 ter and quáter, repealed by Ley 26.734 in 2011.

kind: amendment setting an end date already past
finding: An arrêté of 1 February 2022 replaced the cap's end date '31 décembre 2022' with '31 décembre 2021', a date already past.
Conditional suspension of gun-crime cases requires cooperation 'in the terms of article 17 C', repealed on 4 September 2024 (Ley 21.694).
Three offences for failing to act on 'a notice under section 63'; s 63 was repealed with effect from 1 January 2010.
Prosecution 'for an offence under article 33' and a definition by reference to art. 88, both repealed in 2003; the penalty article still lists repealed arts. 32 and 34.
Vehicle seizure for breaching art. 190, repealed in 2001.

provision: Northwest Territories Boilers and Pressure Vessels Act s 43(1)(g)
finding: A certificate can be suspended for failing to give 'the notice required by section 47', repealed in 1993 by the same Act that amended s 43.
The GMO moratorium ran until 31 December 2025; its extension to 2030 took effect on 1 August 2026, not retroactively.
Algorithmic video surveillance was authorised until 31 March 2025; the extension took effect on 22 March 2026, not retroactively.
The extended ban on church institutions selling heritage to private buyers lapsed from 1 January to 28 June 2017.
The suspension of evictions for vulnerable households had no legal basis for 7 days in January 2025 and 8 days in early 2026, and none since 28 February 2026.
Meal vouchers could not legally buy groceries from 1 to 22 January 2025.
Cities could not create new capital investment incentive programmes from 1 January to 24 September 2024.
The ban on vehicle subscription programmes lapsed from 1 to 4 May 2019.

provision: Arrêté du 8 juin 2015 arts. 4 bis, 4 ter
finding: The 100 kg-per-trip mackerel discard cap lapsed from 1 January to 30 December 2021.
